title: Docker Compose in 12 Minutes
comment_samples: This is the 50th or so video I've watched on containers and the FIRST one that made sense
In 12 minutes I learned more than the tutorials I was reading for the whole day.
Straight to the point. Great attention to details in the video production as well. Love it!

9 years later, and no matter how many updates Docker has gone through, this is still an exelllent guide. It is very easy-to-follow, focused on the subject, and clear.

Great work.
5yrs later and this video is still relevant. Straight to the point.  Nothing beats a great content.
